note: The replaced test told the originals apart by name; name is one register-level fact, so a second name would stop ANSWER forming at all. They differ here in their operational definition, a delivery-level text the pin also covers.
fails_if: `compile_occurrence_corrections` selects originals by column and edition alone, so CVID 21 (another operational definition) also moves to 2016, or the entry is refused as ambiguous

sources.description: Edition 99 (2009) delivers ANSWER twice for variable 5: CVID 20, and CVID 21 with operational definition 'Distinct ninth event'.
